artifact_inventory.candidate_selection.csv: df grid and development component-density selection
artifact_inventory.excluded_rows.csv: all audited impossible primitive fields excluded from primitive factors
artifact_inventory.model_spec.json: exact frozen model specification and development selection record
artifact_inventory.summary.json: machine-readable configuration, metrics, selection, and integrity

candidate_selection.comparison: sequential A vs V1, B vs A, C vs B
candidate_selection.forced_reporting_candidate: A when no A/B/C clears its predecessor; this does not imply promotion

distribution.fit: equal-total-weight rank-pair pseudo-observations per game; robust IRLS
distribution.scale: one fitted robust residual scale per conditional component; no outcome-dependent retuning

factorization.a: p(margin | ranks, site) * p(yards_diff | plays_diff, plays_total, yards_total, margin, ranks, site, pairing)
factorization.b: p(margin | ranks, site) * p(plays_diff | plays_total, margin, ranks, site, pairing) * p(yards_diff | plays_diff, plays_total, yards_total, margin, ranks, site, pairing)
factorization.c: B with separate interceptions_thrown_diff/total and fumbles_lost_diff/total as context covariates in both conditional components; no p(INT,FL | ranks)

frozen_production_integrity.scope: production posterior, priors/H-C, performance, weekly updates, and website trees

missing_data.b: missing plays disables play factor; missing yards disables yards factor; if no usable factor remains -> V1
missing_data.c: missing either INT-thrown or fumbles-lost value for either team falls back exactly to B for that game
missing_data.rule: missing is not zero; each factor requires the complete fields it conditions on

selection_rule.comparison: sequential A vs V1, B vs A, C vs B
selection_rule.forced_reporting_candidate: A when no A/B/C clears its predecessor; this does not imply promotion

pairing_support.fit: primitive parameters are fit only on FBS-FBS and FBS-FCS rows
pairing_support.inference: FCS-FCS and unsupported/missing primitive evidence use the exact V1 margin factor for that game

play_signal.interpretation: positive quality slope means more play differential is associated with the better final-rank side after the fixed margin/site/overall-volume conditioning model; it is descriptive, not a direct play-count rating factor

primitive_representation.lossless_claim: diff plus total is an invertible representation of each selected pair of team values
primitive_representation.orientation: same-subdivision home-minus-away; cross-subdivision FBS-minus-FCS regardless of listing order

promotion_assessment.future_comparison_scope: all non-empty standard cutoffs; final cutoff has no future games by construction
promotion_assessment.recommendation: Primitive evidence is not strong enough to promote a Likelihood V2 candidate on this leakage-safe historical evaluation.

rank_basis.coordinates: V1 percentile coordinates: same-subdivision rank surface uses odd d, d*mean, d*mean^2, d*abs(d), and d*hinges; cross-subdivision uses FBS/FCS percentile surface and site indicators
rank_basis.rank_signal_null: rank coordinates are set to zero in the reserved V1 rank columns; context and margin/site columns remain
rank_basis.rank_support: the same rank supports supplied by historical_modeling_games.csv and frozen final PMF supports for scoring

research_question: Does retaining yards and plays separately recover useful latent FBS quality information that YPP collapses?

response_transforms.turnover_diff_and_total_context: asinh(value / 1.0), separately for INT thrown and fumbles lost

scope_exclusions: production Likelihood V2 and website/publication changes

selection_rule.comparison: sequential A vs V1, B vs A, C vs B
selection_rule.forced_reporting_candidate: A when no A/B/C clears its predecessor; this does not imply promotion

temporal_design.evaluation: 2022-2025 leakage-safe historical evaluation/prospective-style validation; not independent confirmation
temporal_design.rolling: target seasons 2008-2025 fit primitive components only on earlier seasons; no 2026 outcomes

ypp_comparator.name: ypp_supported
ypp_comparator.retuning: none; fit specification and df are fixed to the merged PR #17 result
